name: Extra Defensive Stance
body:
You can maintain your defensive stance longer.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive stance class feature.

Benefit(s): You can maintain your defensive stance for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Defensive Stance multiple times. Its effects stack.
